name: jdbi
description: SQL-first persistence with JDBI 3: SqlObject and Fluent API, row mapping to records, transactions, injection-safe binding, N+1 avoidance, batching, keyset pagination, optimistic locking, schema migrations.
decides: The stack ADR chooses JDBI for data access.

options.description: No ORM: JPA, Hibernate ORM/Reactive and Panache are blocked (Hibernate Validator stays allowed).
JDBI stays in infrastructure adapters; domain packages may not import org.jdbi.
Schema migrations with Flyway under src/main/resources/db/migration/ (versioned V<n>__<desc>.sql).
